text: Professional OverviewElectrical Engineering (EE for short) is a core and key discipline in the field of modern science and technology. Traditionally, it has been defined as the sum total of related disciplines used to create and produce electrical and electronic systems. With the development of technology, today's electrical engineering encompasses almost all engineering behaviors related to electronics and photons, and its research content and application fields are constantly expanding and deepening.Training objectivesThe aim is to cultivate broad-based "compound" senior engineering and technical talents who can engage in work in fields related to electrical engineering, such as system operation, automatic control, power electronics technology, information processing, experimental analysis, research and development, economic management, and the application of electronic and computer technology.
